name: Homeless Shelter | Season 2
description:
HALLOWEEN NIGHT V3: Saturday 31 October (Halloween), 4pm UK time.

A one-night server event, back for a third round with changes from player feedback. Pick a class, each with its own abilities, survive the waves together in a multi-level arena, then take on the final boss. Points go into a shop with gear you can't get anywhere else. Event gear is provided and your own items are stored safely while you're in, so new players can just join.

Homeless Shelter is a small survival server, now in Season 2. Java and Bedrock (1.7 to 26.3) play in the same world, and you can play the real game in your browser without owning Minecraft: https://playsheltr.pages.dev

Most of it is normal survival:

- Land claims (golden shovel), homes, /spawn and /rtp

- Skills that level up as you play

- Ore and tree veinmining

- Proximity voice chat (Simple Voice Chat, optional)

- PvP, opt out with /pvp

- 95 new biomes, 118 structures and a harder Nether

- The Hollow, a Halloween mob dimension that pays shop points

- A custom secret dimension we built ourselves

- /guide in game explains everything

Java players set a password with /register the first time they join.

Discord: https://discord.gg/qhr7dJC3KM
